classification.difficultyReason: Identify the known and unknown sides relative to each angle, select sine, cosine or tangent, and multiply by the known side.

content.prompt: Calculate the value of the pronumeral, to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Horizontal base, vertical right side, rising hypotenuse and bottom-right right-angle square. Ordinary source blue outlines are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: Hypotenuse 2; bottom-left angle 35 degrees; opposite side a. Coordinates preserve the stated acute angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown label are visible.

answer.worked:
Relative to $35^{\circ}$, $a$ is opposite and $2$ is the hypotenuse. Use sine.
$$\begin{align*}\sin\theta&=\frac{O}{H}\\\sin35^{\circ}&=\frac{a}{2}\\a&=2\sin35^{\circ}\\a&\approx1.15\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Shallow triangle with horizontal base and vertical right side. Right-angle square is at bottom right; ordinary outlines and labels are black.
spec.mathematics: Hypotenuse 4; bottom-left angle 15 degrees; adjacent base b. Coordinates preserve the stated acute angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown label are visible.

answer.worked:
Relative to $15^{\circ}$, $b$ is adjacent and $4$ is the hypotenuse. Use cosine.
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{A}{H}\\\cos15^{\circ}&=\frac{b}{4}\\b&=4\cos15^{\circ}\\b&\approx3.86\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Tall triangle with horizontal base, vertical right side and bottom-right right-angle square; ordinary outlines and labels are black.
spec.mathematics: Adjacent base 5; bottom-left angle 70 degrees; opposite side y. Coordinates preserve the stated acute angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown label are visible.

answer.worked:
Relative to $70^{\circ}$, $y$ is opposite and $5$ is adjacent. Use tangent.
$$\begin{align*}\tan\theta&=\frac{O}{A}\\\tan70^{\circ}&=\frac{y}{5}\\y&=5\tan70^{\circ}\\y&\approx13.74\end{align*}$$
